verses.zh: 为西缅支派的人，按着宗族，拈出第二阄。他们所得的地业是在犹大人地业中间。
verses.en: The second lot belonged to the tribe of Simeon by its clans.[NOTE:1] Their assigned land was in the middle of Judah’s assigned land.
notes: Heb “and the second lot came out for Simeon, for the tribe of the sons of Simeon by their clans.”tc The LXX, Syriac, and Vulgate omit “for Simeon.”

verses.zh: 他们所得为业之地就是：别是巴（或名示巴）、摩拉大、
verses.en: Their assigned land included[NOTE:1] Beer Sheba,[NOTE:2] Moladah,
notes: Heb “and they had in their inheritance.”

The MT has “and Sheba” listed after “Beer Sheba.” The LXX suggests “Shema.” The Hebrew text may be defective here, since the form “Sheba” duplicates the latter part of the preceding name. If Sheba (or Shema) is retained as a separate city, the list numbers fourteen, one more than the number given in the concluding summary (v. 6). Some translations treat it as an alternate shorter name for “Beer Sheba” rendering it as “or Sheba;” cf. HCSB, TNIV, and JPS.

verses.zh: 哈萨・书亚、巴拉、以森、
verses.en: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,

verses.zh: 伊利多拉、比土力、何珥玛、
verses.en: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,

verses.zh: 洗革拉、伯・玛加博、哈萨・苏撒、
verses.en: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,

verses.zh: 伯・利巴勿、沙鲁险，共十三座城，还有属城的村庄；
verses.en: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen—a total of 13 cities and their towns,

verses.zh: 又有亚因、利门、以帖、亚珊，共四座城，还有属城的村庄；
verses.en: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan—a total of four cities and their towns,

verses.zh: 并有这些城邑四围一切的村庄，直到巴拉・比珥，就是南地的拉玛。这是西缅支派按着宗族所得的地业。
verses.en: as well as all the towns around these cities as far as Baalath Beer (Ramah of the Negev). This was the land assigned to the tribe of Simeon by its clans.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “this was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Simeon.”

verses.zh: 西缅人的地业是从犹大人地业中得来的；因为犹大人的分过多，所以西缅人在他们的地业中得了地业。
verses.en: Simeon’s assigned land was taken from Judah’s allotted portion, for Judah’s territory was too large for them; so Simeon was assigned land within Judah.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “from the portion of the sons of Judah was the inheritance of the sons of Simeon for the portion of the sons of Judah was too large for them, and the sons of Simeon received an inheritance in the midst of their inheritance.”

verses.zh: 为西布伦人，按着宗族，拈出第三阄。他们地业的境界是到撒立；
verses.en: The third lot belonged to the tribe of Zebulun[NOTE:1] by its clans. The border of their territory[NOTE:2] extended to Sarid.
notes: Heb “and the third lot came up for the sons of Zebulun.”
Or “inheritance.”

verses.zh: 往西上到玛拉拉，达到大巴设，又达到约念前的河；
verses.en: Their border went up westward to Maralah and touched Dabbesheth and the valley near[NOTE:1] Jokneam.
notes: Heb “in front of”; perhaps “east of.”

verses.zh: 又从撒立往东转向日出之地，到吉斯绿・他泊的境界，又通到大比拉，上到雅非亚；
verses.en: From Sarid it turned eastward[NOTE:1] to the territory of Kisloth Tabor, extended to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.
notes: Heb “eastward toward the rising of the sun.”

verses.zh: 从那里往东，接连到迦特・希弗，至以特・加汛，通到临门，临门延到尼亚；
verses.en: From there it crossed eastward to Gath Hepher and Eth Kazin, and extended to Rimmon, turning toward Neah.

verses.zh: 又绕过尼亚的北边，转到哈拿顿，通到伊弗他・伊勒谷。
verses.en: It then turned on the north to Hannathon and ended at the Valley of Iphtah El.

verses.zh: 还有加他、拿哈拉、伸仑、以大拉、伯利恒，共十二座城，还有属城的村庄。
verses.en: Their territory included Kattah, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem;[NOTE:1] in all they had 12 cities and their towns.[NOTE:2]
notes: For location see Map5-B1; Map7-E2; Map8-E2; Map10-B4.
Heb “Kattah, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem, 12 cities and their towns.” The words “their territory included” and “in all they had” are supplied in the translation for clarification.

verses.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是西布伦人按着宗族所得的地业。
verses.en: This was the land assigned to the tribe of Zebulun[NOTE:1] by its clans, including these cities and their towns.
notes: Heb “this is the inheritance of the sons of Zebulun.”

verses.zh: 为以萨迦人，按着宗族，拈出第四阄。
verses.en: The fourth lot belonged to the tribe of Issachar[NOTE:1] by its clans.
notes: Heb “the fourth lot came out for the sons of Issachar.”

verses.zh: 他们的境界是到耶斯列、基苏律、书念、
verses.en: Their assigned land[NOTE:1] included Jezreel, Kesulloth, Shunem,
notes: Or “their inheritance.”

verses.zh: 哈弗连、示按、亚拿哈拉、
verses.en: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,

verses.zh: 拉璧、基善、亚别、
verses.en: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,

verses.zh: 利篾、隐・干宁、隐・哈大、伯・帕薛；
verses.en: Remeth, En Gannim, En Haddah and Beth Pazzez.

verses.zh: 又达到他泊、沙哈洗玛、伯・示麦，直通到约旦河为止，共十六座城，还有属城的村庄。
verses.en: Their border touched Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh, and ended at the Jordan. They had 16 cities and their towns.

verses.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是以萨迦支派按着宗族所得的地业。
verses.en: This was the land assigned to the tribe of Issachar[NOTE:1] by its clans, including these cities and their towns.
notes: Heb “this was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Issachar.”

verses.zh: 为亚设支派，按着宗族，拈出第五阄。
verses.en: The fifth lot belonged to the tribe of Asher[NOTE:1] by its clans.
notes: Heb “and the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the sons of Asher.”

verses.zh: 他们的境界是黑甲、哈利、比田、押煞、
verses.en: Their territory included Helkath, Hali, Beten, Acshaph,

verses.zh: 亚拉米勒、亚末、米沙勒；往西达到迦密，又到希曷・立纳，
verses.en: Alammelech, Amad, and Mishal. Their border touched Carmel to the west and Shihor Libnath.

verses.zh: 转向日出之地，到伯・大衮，达到细步纶；往北到伊弗他・伊勒谷，到伯・以墨和尼业，也通到迦步勒的左边；
verses.en: It turned eastward toward Beth Dagon, touched Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtah El to the north, as well as Beth Emek and Neiel, and extended to Cabul on the north[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “left.”

verses.zh: 又到义伯仑、利合、哈们、加拿，直到西顿大城；
verses.en: and on to Ebron,[NOTE:1] Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, as far as Greater Sidon.[NOTE:2]
notes: Some Hebrew mss read “Abdon.”
For location see Map1-A1; JP3-F3; JP4-F3.

verses.zh: 转到拉玛和坚固城泰尔；又转到何萨，靠近亚革悉一带地方，直通到海；
verses.en: It then turned toward Ramah as far as the fortified city of Tyre,[NOTE:1] turned to Hosah, and ended at the sea near Hebel, Achzib,
notes: For location see Map1-A2; Map2-G2; Map4-A1; JP3-F3; JP4-F3.

verses.zh: 又有乌玛、亚弗、利合，共二十二座城，还有属城的村庄。
verses.en: Umah, Aphek, and Rehob. In all they had[NOTE:1] 22 cities and their towns.
notes: The words “in all they had” are supplied in the translation for clarification.

verses.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是亚设支派按着宗族所得的地业。
verses.en: This was the land assigned to the tribe of Asher[NOTE:1] by its clans, including these cities and their towns.
notes: Heb “this was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Asher.”

verses.zh: 为拿弗他利人，按着宗族，拈出第六阄。
verses.en: The sixth lot belonged to the tribe of Naphtali[NOTE:1] by its clans.
notes: Heb “the sixth lot came out for the sons of Naphtali, for the sons of Naphtali.”

verses.zh: 他们的境界是从希利弗从撒拿音的橡树，从亚大米・尼吉和雅比聂，直到拉共，通到约旦河；
verses.en: Their border started at Heleph and the oak of Zaanannim, went to Adami Nekeb, Jabneel and on to Lakkum,[NOTE:1] and ended at the Jordan River.[NOTE:2]
notes: Heb “and their border was from Heleph, from the oak of Zaanannim, and Adami Nekeb, and Jabneel to Lakkum.”
The word “River” is not in the Hebrew text, but has been supplied for clarity.

verses.zh: 又转向西到亚斯纳・他泊，从那里通到户割，南边到西布伦，西边到亚设，又向日出之地，达到约旦河那里的犹大。
verses.en: It turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, extended from there to Hukok, touched Zebulun on the south, Asher on the west, and the Jordan[NOTE:1] on the east.
notes: The MT reads “Judah, the Jordan”; the LXX omits “Judah.” Perhaps there was a town named Judah, distinct from the tribe of Judah, located near the northern end of the Jordan.

verses.zh: 坚固的城就是：西丁、侧耳、哈末、拉甲、基尼烈、
verses.en: The fortified cities included Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Kinnereth,

verses.zh: 亚大玛、拉玛、夏琐、
verses.en: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,[NOTE:1]
notes: For location see Map1-D2; Map2-D3; Map3-A2; Map4-C1.

verses.zh: 基低斯、以得来、隐・夏琐、
verses.en: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,

verses.zh: 以利稳、密大・伊勒、和琏、伯・亚纳、伯・示麦，共十九座城，还有属城的村庄。
verses.en: Yiron,[NOTE:1] Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh. In all they had[NOTE:2] 19 cities and their towns.
notes: Instead of Yiron some English translations read Iron.
The words “in all they had” are supplied in the translation for clarification.

verses.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是拿弗他利支派按着宗族所得的地业。
verses.en: This was the land assigned to the tribe of Naphtali[NOTE:1] by its clans, including these cities and their towns.
notes: Heb “this was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali.”

verses.zh: 为但支派，按着宗族，拈出第七阄。
verses.en: The seventh lot belonged to the tribe of Dan[NOTE:1] by its clans.
notes: Heb “the seventh lot came out for the sons of Dan.”

verses.zh: 他们地业的境界是琐拉、以实陶、伊珥・示麦、
verses.en: Their assigned land included Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir Shemesh,

verses.zh: 沙拉宾、亚雅仑、伊提拉、
verses.en: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,

verses.zh: 以伦、亭拿他、以革伦、
verses.en: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,

verses.zh: 伊利提基、基比顿、巴拉、
verses.en: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,

verses.zh: 伊胡得、比尼・比拉、迦特・临门、
verses.en: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,

verses.zh: 美・耶昆、拉昆，并约帕对面的地界。
verses.en: the waters of Jarkon, and Rakkon, including the territory in front of Joppa.

verses.zh: 但人的地界越过原得的地界；因为但人上去攻取利善，用刀击杀城中的人，得了那城，住在其中，以他们先祖但的名将利善改名为但。
verses.en: (The Danites failed to conquer their territory,[NOTE:1] so they went up and fought with Leshem and captured it. They put the sword to it, took possession of it, and lived in it. They renamed it[NOTE:2] Dan after their ancestor.[NOTE:3])
notes: Heb “the territory of the sons of Dan went out from them.”
Heb “Leshem.” The pronoun (“it”) has replaced the name “Leshem” in the translation for stylistic reasons.
Heb “according to the name of their father.”

verses.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是但支派按着宗族所得的地业。
verses.en: This was the land assigned to the tribe of Dan[NOTE:1] by its clans, including these cities and their towns.
notes: Heb “this was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Dan.”

verses.zh: 以色列人按着境界分完了地业，就在他们中间将地给嫩的儿子约书亚为业，
verses.en: When they finished dividing the land into its regions, the Israelites gave Joshua son of Nun some land.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “an inheritance in their midst.”

verses.zh: 是照耶和华的吩咐，将约书亚所求的城，就是以法莲山地的亭拿・西拉城，给了他。他就修那城，住在其中。
verses.en: As the Lord had instructed, they gave him the city he requested—Timnath Serah in the Ephraimite hill country. He built up the city and lived in it.

verses.zh: 这就是祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列各支派的族长，在示罗会幕门口，耶和华面前，拈阄所分的地业。这样，他们把地分完了。
verses.en: These are the land assignments that Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the Israelite tribal leaders[NOTE:1] made by drawing lots in Shiloh before the Lord at the entrance of the tent of meeting.[NOTE:2] So they finished dividing up the land.
notes: Heb “the leaders of the fathers of the tribes.”
Heb “at the entrance of the tent of assembly.”sn On the tent of meeting see Exod 33:7-11.
